cues.text: Hi, and welcome.
I'm happy you made the choice to meditate today.
Before we start, just take a second to get yourself comfortable.
Maybe you’re sitting on the couch.
Maybe you’re on a pillow or lying down on your bed.
There’s no right or wrong position here.
Just choose whatever feels good for you.
Take a look around you, and then, when you’re ready, let your eyes close.
Or keep them open if that feels more comfortable.
You don’t have to do anything special right now.
You don’t have to clear your mind or stop your thoughts.
Just give yourself a few quiet minutes to slow down.
Feel the place where your body is touching the surface underneath you, below you.
Notice that you’re supported.
Let your shoulders drop a little.
Relax your hands.
Let your body be comfortable.
And now, take a slow breath in…
And let it go.
No need to force anything.
Just breathe normally.
Take one more slow breath in…
And slowly breathe out.
Today, we’re going to imagine a peaceful,
quiet garden and learn two words we might use when we talk about it: “shadow” and “shade.”
Let's begin.
Imagine, in your mind, a garden.
It doesn't need to be a real place.
Simply imagine whatever garden feels peaceful to you, full of soft green plants,
and quiet corners to rest.
Picture yourself sitting somewhere in this garden, comfortable and calm.
Maybe on a bench.
Maybe on the grass.
Whatever feels right.
Imagine it’s a very hot, sunny day.
The sun is strong, and you want to get away from it.
You might say to a friend, “It’s too hot.
Let’s find some shade.”
Shade is an area that is protected from the direct sunlight.
A tree can provide shade, and you can sit or stand in the shade to get away from the sun.
Look around this garden.
Imagine that there are lots of plants here that like the shade.
They grow well because they are protected from the strong sunlight.
Take a slow breath in…
and breathe out.
Imagine yourself sitting comfortably in the shade of a tree.
Now, look down at the ground.
Can you see the dark shape made by the tree?
That is its shadow.
A shadow is a dark shape made when something blocks the sunlight.
You can see your shadow on the ground.
Maybe you’re standing next to a friend, and notice that your shadow is taller than theirs.
You could say, “Look at my shadow!
It’s taller than yours.”
Shade is a cool area protected from direct sunlight,
while a shadow is the dark shape made when something blocks the light.
Take another slow breath in…
and breathe out.
You are sitting in the shade, protected from the sun,
while the tree’s shadow rests on the ground beside you.
Notice how peaceful this garden feels.
No rush.
No noise.
Just quiet green plants, gentle sunlight, and this comfortable,
cool shade surrounding you.
Let your body feel just as calm as this garden.
Let your breath move just as gently as the breeze through the leaves.
Take a breath in…
and let it out slowly.
This garden will always be here, whenever you need it.
A quiet place to sit, protected in the shade,
watching the shadows move gently across the ground.
Let these gentle words settle into your mind.
I can rest in this quiet, peaceful place.
I am protected, like sitting in gentle shade.
I am calm, like a shadow resting quietly on the ground.
I am safe.
I am at peace.
Take another slow breath, and let these words settle a little deeper.
Stay here for a while longer, resting in this imagined garden,
feeling the shade around you, and watching the shadow move softly nearby.
There's no need to rush away from this feeling.
Let yourself stay here, calm and comfortable, for as long as you'd like.
When you feel ready, begin to bring awareness back to the room around you gently.
Notice the surface beneath you.
Notice your breath, still slow, still steady.
Let your fingers move first, just slightly.
Then your toes.
Small movements, gentle and unhurried.
Take your time returning.
There's no hurry.
Whenever you're ready, let your eyes open softly, taking in the light around you.
Carry this quiet garden with you into the rest of your day.
Whenever you need a moment of peace, remember this place, this shade, this shadow,
resting quietly, always here, waiting for you to return.
You are calm.
You are at peace.
And you are exactly where you need to be.
